svg.text: code_tracer — Physical topology: what is written where, read by whom
Stores, not services. Red border = a component we build.
W: what is WRITTEN into this store — or, for an actor, what it writes out
R: what is READ from this store — or, for an actor, what it reads in
solid arrow = write path · dashed arrow = read path · green = admitted artifact
PUBLIC UPSTREAM · the anchor — nobody in the alliance controls it · write access: none of ours
R: CVE record, pinned at scoping
Anchor strength varies: Maven/Go strong · npm, PyPI permit
deletion, so a baseline can vanish → supplementary log
OUTSIDE · alliance (issuer) · provider · the contract's signatories — evidence PRODUCTION
W: Rego policy bundles · compiler ①
publishing surface — never read at verify
witnessed by the signatories: each L8
carries the checkpoint it observed, so
a split view surfaces as dissent
R: baseline from the package registry · source from upstream git · L-1
W: hardened artifact · L0–L7 · recipe set (own git)
W: delivery manifest, digest logged at hand-off
the recipe repo is peripheral — never on the verification path
R: delivery manifest · baseline re-pulled from the public registry
W: one L8 each — rebuild digest, L4/L5 recheck, observed checkpoint
every signatory verifies · all must agree · minimum two
the parties that sign and fund the contract are the parties that check it
by replay, so omission is detectable
THE PERIMETER — a copy crosses, not a protocol. TWO containers: the issuer seals the evidence core once; each bank seals its own ingest envelope around it.

Sealing confers no authority on the contents · RESOLUTION is online — discovery, the pinned rebuild inputs, and the bank's own rebuild · VERIFICATION is offline · core has no clock · envelope: TUF ≤ 7d, checkpoints ≤ 24h
INSIDE THE BANK · the gate is hermetic and offline — no live call outward once the envelope is sealed · evidence CONSUMPTION
refreshed on a cadence, never at verify
R: one envelope + the core it names
W on admit · R by app teams only
W: package on arrival · nothing reads it but the gate
R only: which apps deploy which package
R: projections + verdicts · writes nothing durable
Every durable write inside the bank is append-only:
verdicts and bundles are immutable, ledger events are
hash-chained. Everything else is a projection.

· It is not "two GitHubs." Git appears twice — the alliance master repo (schemas, policy, compiler, contracts, cores) and the provider's recipe repo — and neither repository's own hashing is load-bearing.
· Artifact bytes are never duplicated: they stay in the ecosystem-native repo. A central digest→attestation index supplies discovery, and it is deliberately untrusted.
· Evidence is shared because it is frozen; trust material is per-bank because its clock runs at that bank's gate. That split is why one core carries one digest for the whole membership.
· Open: verifier rebuild siting · the air-gapped courier variant and its staging hosts · rebuild-input durability, since a pinned locator can stop resolving while every digest still checks out.
